summary.text: STIFTELSEN DET NASJONALE ALDERSHJEM FOR SJØMENN I STAVERN is a foundation registered in Stavern, founded 1905-05-12. Stiftelsen Det Nasjonale Aldershjem for Sjømenn i Stavern provides housing for elderly seafarers with long service at sea, both single and married, from all over Norway. The foundation consists of a department with elderly housing and a nursing home department with round-the-clock care. It was previously named DET NASJ ALDERSHJ FOR SJØMENN I STAVERN until 1996-07-02. Its main industry code is 87.102: nursing care activities in nursing homes. The register shows 62 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 45 793 474 NOK and the annual result was 849 056 NOK; operating income was up from 44 245 353 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 708 723 NOK in 2024 to 849 056 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 30 162 924 NOK in 2024 to 31 011 985 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
